description: The pie chart represents the distribution of categories in a dataset. There are six categories in total: chat, math, tooluse, multi turn chat, code, and instruction follow. The chat category has the largest proportion, accounting for 41.2% of the dataset. The math category follows with 21.9%, and the tooluse category has 11.6%. The multi turn chat, code, and instruction follow categories have smaller proportions, with 9.3%, 9.0%, and 6.9% respectively. The chart does not include any visual emphasis on specific slices, such as exploded or offset slices, and there are no percentage labels inside the slices. The slices are ordered in descending size, starting with chat and ending with instruction follow.
